status: Proposed implementation contract. CSS and sample behavior are provided; application adapters and production integration remain required.

global.logo: Load the supplied current-revision SVG. Preserve all geometry; the three short ray marks removed on 19 November 2026 must not be restored. No filter, mask, recolor, distortion or procedural redraw.
global.art: Choose an asset ID from the delivered manifest and honor its review status; dimensions explicit; alt empty when decorative.
global.target: 48 CSS px main controls; 44 CSS px secondary controls.
global.keyboard: Every clickable control uses native semantics and visible focus.
global.events: Server/app events drive success, progress and achievement state; no timer-generated success.

components.name: BrandLogo
rules: Preserve intrinsic aspect ratio.
Accessible home link name is Jems home.
Never replace a missing asset with generated artwork.

components.name: Button
props: variant: primary | blue | mint | gold | secondary | quiet | danger
rules: Keep visible text when busy.
aria-busy announces in-flight work; prevent duplicate mutations in application logic.
Use native disabled when unavailable; associate explanatory help where needed.

components.name: GameCard
rules: Do not nest buttons inside links.
A separate visible or labeled options control provides remove/archive without opening the game.
Card art describes the game, not a new logo.

components.name: IdeaComposer
rules: Label remains visible.
Enter behavior must not interfere with multiline input or speech review.
Sending a message does not automatically accept an edit.

components.name: BuildStatus
props: stage: queued | building | testing | repairing | ready | failed | cancelled
rules: Never invent a percentage or ETA.
When progress is unknown omit aria-valuenow.
Polite stage announcements are throttled; avoid per-frame screen reader updates.
Keep a verified recoverable game available when one exists; show neutral failure copy otherwise.

components.name: VoiceControl
props: state: idle | recording | transcribing | review | blocked | empty | failed
rules: Microphone click starts a user-approved recording flow.
Stop is always available during recording.
Review text before Send.
Typing remains an alternative.
Recording indicator uses text and shape, never color alone.

components.name: Banner
rules: No attention animation on errors.
Recovery action stays visible.
Decorative art is separate from live message text.

components.name: Toast
rules: Create polite live region before adding content.
No automatic disappearance for required actions.
Critical messages remain inline as well.
Undo/remove announcements reflect successful application events.

components.name: Achievement
rules: Trigger once per verified event.
Use PR57 highest-stage logic: saved idea -> rough / Gem Maker; saved experiment plus linked child observation -> cut / Gem Cutter; cut plus confirmed kept version -> polished / Gem Polisher.
Never promote through points, repeated clicks or a visual timer.
At most one large celebration at a time.
Dismiss without blocking return to play.
Never claim tested learning gains from game completion.

Gem Master is the requested fourth builder level. Inspected PR57 draft b12a2a5 currently uses three independent qualifying polished projects. Runtime eligibility remains achievement-adapter owned; this art library does not evaluate or award it.
Primary rank artwork is the chosen human maker in the exact level outfit, holding the original level jem. Reuse the same source frame in Journey, rank card, chooser and popup.
Use a soft Cloud or lilac thumbnail tile at 96–192 CSS px; contain the full 3:4 figure. No metal medal, ornate frame, crown or replacement gem hero.
Changing maker preserves the selected or verified earned level. Changing the demo level updates the thumbnail, title, reason, Journey and both chooser portraits together.
Standalone source jems are secondary 16–32 CSS px progress icons only. Master uses the original rainbow star, held by the original level 4 maker.

components.name: Dialog
rules: Use showModal so the background is inert.
Label the dialog with aria-labelledby.
Restore focus to the opener on close.
Escape closes unless a brief non-cancellable operation truly requires otherwise.
Focus least destructive action for destructive confirmations.

components.name: EmptyState
rules: Provide one clear next action.
Keep language reassuring and literal.
Offline state does not promise an unsaved idea is stored.

components.name: ParentSummary
rules: Calmer artwork density and motion.
Always distinguish practice activity, assessed ability and causal improvement.
Do not show percentages without denominator and method.

components.name: Navigation
rules: Use aria-current=page.
Do not hide required navigation behind hover.
Keep labels at tablet and phone sizes when feasible.

components.name: Switch
rules: Input retains native accessibility.
Visible label describes the setting.
Audio stays user-controllable.

components.name: MakerChooser
components.element: dialog with fieldset and native radio inputs
rules: Use Spark and Nova names without gender labels.
Show the retained maker asset at the same preview level for both choices.
Provide an accessible dialog name, visible close control, Escape handling and return focus.
Character preference changes appearance only; preserve all verified earned progress.
Catalog selection is local and does not store a preference or contact an account.
Both chooser portraits use the currently previewed or verified earned level; do not reset to a different outfit when opening the chooser.

components.name: Journey
rules: Use maker_spark_1..4 or maker_nova_1..4 with native aspect ratio and object-fit contain.
Display current-revision identity separately from artwork; never use an old screenshot header as artwork.
Previewing an outfit does not award, lock or unlock progress.

Production earned markers, progress fractions and next steps require the achievement adapter. The inspected draft Master policy uses three independent qualifying polished projects; a preview selection cannot supply that evidence.
Treat the five-pose gemstone helper as Gem companion, distinct from the named human maker Spark.
Every primary rank image is the chosen maker in the exact rank outfit holding the original jem; use the same rank-thumbnail recipe across cards, chooser and popup.
Standalone gem_rough, gem_cut, gem_polished_rainbow and gem_master are secondary compact progress icons only. Never use a medal or bare gem as the primary rank visual.

coverage.art: Welcoming workshop hero; optional small helper
Collection spot art; own game thumbnails
One small supporting character; quiet reading area
Workshop activity loop or static calm equivalent
Small finished gem or approved launch illustration
Game world owns artwork; shell stays restrained
Chosen Spark or Nova in the exact earned-rank outfit, original held jem intact, on a soft rank-thumbnail tile. Same artwork in card and nonblocking popup.
Calm helper repair/connection spot; no sad punishment
Quiet accents; no success claims baked into artwork

coverage.surface: Choose your maker and My journey
coverage.art: Eight exact Spark/Nova outfit frames, clean journey scenery and four original source jems for secondary tiny progress icons.

celebrations.trigger: ordinary successful save or accepted action
celebrations.visual: brief check or tiny gem shine
brief chosen-maker rank thumbnail reveal in a nonblocking message

celebrations.trigger: verified Gem Studio stage transition, only where existing product behavior supports it
celebrations.visual: single dismissible panel with approved art
celebrations.interruptsPlay: only at a safe transition, never mid-input
